   || ! [ -s "${fixture_root}/host.suites" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: ubuntu_write_deb822_source is asymmetric for equal flags (host vs ports):" >&2
  diff -u "${fixture_root}/host.suites" "${fixture_root}/ports.suites" | sed 's/^/    /' >&2
  _mirror_consistency_error
fi
why: equal flags must yield equal suite sets; a helper that special-cases the host arch defeats every call-site check above it
this is the compiler-stage host stanza that cost riscv64 its Qt6: amd64 without -security stranded libcurl3t64-gnutls one version behind ports and broke Multi-Arch:same co-installation
the function existing but never being called from the host-sources rewrite is the exact shape this repo keeps shipping

find:
'/^Suites:/ && !added { print $0 " " sec; added = 1; next } { print }' || return 1
  _CROSS_ENV_APT_UPDATED=0
replace: '/^Suites:/ && !added { print $0 " " sec; added = 1; next } { print }' || return 1
why: a new pocket in the sources is invisible until apt-get update runs again; install_target_packages skips the update when the flag is already 1
without the presence check the stock two-stanza Ubuntu layout gains a duplicate pocket and apt warns "configured multiple times" on every call

find: '/^Suites:/ && !added { print $0 " " sec; added = 1; next } { print }' || return 1
why: appending the pocket to every stanza double-defines it across mirrors that carry different subsets

find:
rm -f "${tmp}"
    printf '%s: awk rewrite of %s failed; file left unchanged\n' \
      "${caller}" "${sources_file}" >&2
    return 1
  fi
replace:
printf '%s: awk rewrite of %s failed; file left unchanged\n' \
      "${caller}" "${sources_file}" >&2
  fi
why: the original mv'd unconditionally, so a failing awk replaced the host sources with truncated output and still returned 0 -- every later apt-get died with 'Unable to locate package' and no trace of the cause
mktemp creates 0600 and mv carries that mode onto the target; apt sources are 0644 root:root everywhere else in /etc/apt/sources.list.d
an unanchored match hits a COMMENT naming the pocket and silently disables the whole repair on a file that does not carry it

find: _vulkan_sdk_components_ref+=(vulkan-tools gfxreconstruct vcv slang vulkantools dxc cdl)
why: a name dropped here takes the CHECKOUT with it, so the row skips at the -d test and is never even counted as attempted -- exactly how riscv64 lost slang and how dxc/vulkantools/cdl went unnoticed for months
most of DXC's option set does not exist until the vendor -C cache file is read; without it the configure takes defaults that build none of the dx* tools
an LLVM 3.7 fork cross-builds its own tblgens for the TARGET and then tries to run them: exit 127, the same Canadian cross llvm-cross.sh and slang already solve
vkconfig-gui is Qt6 and the layers resolve the loader by raw path; without both the component dies the same two ways the caps viewer did

upstream find_package(Qt6 QUIET) skips the whole configurator with a message() and exits 0, so the row counts as BUILT and the SDK ships without vkconfig -- a vacuous success no downstream check can see

MEASURED 2026-09-09: without it the riscv64 cross-build dies at external/SPIRV-Tools/source/util/timer.h on GCC 16 -Warray-bounds promoted by -Werror, and the lane silently ships 23/24 -- the standalone SPIRV-Tools builder in the same file already carries the flag for the identical warning

the helper is unreachable unless _build_vulkan_targets calls it, and without the call both foreign prefixes keep the 1 278 LLVM 3.7 headers and 4 validator libs LunarG's own clean_nonsdk_files drops -- the VK7 asymmetry amd64 has never had
dxc is the LAST row of _VK_TARGET_COMPONENTS and the sole writer of all eight paths; a prune ahead of it deletes nothing and still logs and exits 0, which is the silent shape VK4 already paid for

dxcapi.h is the vendor's own marker that a dxc install landed in THIS prefix; without it the helper rm -rf's include/llvm out of whatever directory it is handed, and /opt/llvm-target's include/llvm is 41 MB of real LLVM 23 headers that LLVMConfig.cmake and 1.3 GB of libLLVM*.a resolve through

find: for rel in include/clang include/clang-c include/llvm include/llvm-c \
replace: for rel in include/dxc include/clang include/clang-c include/llvm include/llvm-c \
why: clean_nonsdk_files KEEPS include/dxc -- build_dxc installs dxcapi.h and WinAdapter.h there on purpose and amd64 ships them; over-pruning swaps the VK7 asymmetry for its mirror image and takes the only public DXC API header with it

find:
-DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
      || log "glslang: shared pass failed; the prefix keeps the static half only"
replace:
-DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF \
      || log "glslang: shared pass failed; the prefix keeps the static half only"
why: VK6: without BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON the first pass is a duplicate of the second and libglslang.so/libSPIRV.so/libglslang-default-resource-limits.so never exist on the foreign arches -- 9 of the 13 files amd64 has and they do not

the LAST install owns lib/cmake/glslang, so a shared-last order makes find_package(glslang) describe SHARED imported targets and silently changes what every consumer links -- the flags are exclusive, not additive
VK6: SPIRV_CROSS_SHARED defaults OFF, so libspirv-cross-c-shared.so* and lib/pkgconfig/spirv-cross-c-shared.pc simply never install on the foreign arches

AS1: false leaves the host -security on security.ubuntu.com while the target pocket comes from the fast mirror -- same pocket, two archives, and a lagging mirror reproduces the Multi-Arch:same skew that cost riscv64 its Qt6

a later checkout failure must restore earlier gitlinks and manifest bytes before rc 1 claims the tree is unchanged

an exact submodule selection must not move an excluded direct gitlink

SIGKILL cannot be trapped, so the marker written before the first byte is the only record that a half-applied tree exists; without it the next run over the same report exited 0 calling the wreckage 'already applied'
